headline: Profit grows on bonder demand but falls from last quarter
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 181.0B (+8.9% y/y) and operating profit KRW 90.8B (+33.9% y/y, margin 50.2%); EPS was KRW 367, down 47.0% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of KRW 367 fell 67.9% q/q and 47.0% y/y on the shard. Reports of the filing put revenue at KRW 181.0B and operating profit at KRW 90.8B, down 27.9% and 30.3% from Q2. The company expects record revenue in Q4 as deferred equipment revenue is recognised. The EPS and operating profit trends do not match, so check the basis.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Revenue and operating profit come from StockHub and Moneytoday reports of the filing. Shard EPS is Yahoo data and looks inconsistent with reported operating profit growth.
